The returned data is public web search content, not host files, databases, SaaS private data, localhost/intranet content, or the API key. Although the query is sent outbound, it is sent to a fixed vendor endpoint, which the SINK definition excludes. The returned search result fields come from external web content via the API and are therefore untrusted/attacker-controllable.
